about: DRAFT labels for the task suite of benchmark v2 (docs/backlog.md, gap BM20). Written by the assistant that also wrote the inference, so they are biased toward it: the owner is to correct every label by hand, then change labelled_by to the owner's name. needs = the smallest set of scopes a careful person would give an agent for this prompt, from: repo.read (read and search files, git log/diff/status), repo.write (create, edit, delete files), tests.run (run the project's tests, linter, typechecker), shell.exec (run any other command: build, install, run a script, start a program). Network is never needed here. note = why, or what is unclear.
